routeLoad.ts loadForSelected() runs `const g = ++generation` (:96) BEFORE `opts.reset?.(...)` (:103). The discard path the arrange view carried since #297 (an open rename silently nulled by the route reset) is gone: the reset now commits the outgoing draft through the same submit path every other commit uses. tasks.commitBody: Roadmap cards now link to their issues, and an issue can carry a short Estonian lead that renders under its title. The link wraps exactly the card's number and title — not the whole card, because an epic's children render inside its article and a whole-card anchor would nest links, which is invalid HTML with undefined click behaviour; wrapping the title region makes nesting impossible by construction, so epics need no special case. The public-audience constraint applies to a lead the moment the Action runs. tasks.commitBody: The repertoire Add Work picker now hides when there is genuinely nothing left to add — and only then. An empty options list has three causes, and only one may hide anything: every library work already in the season's repertoire. The other two stay visible on purpose: lists are blanked synchronously on every reload and refilled asynchronously, so gating naively on emptiness would make the control vanish and reappear on each load, and a failed load renders visible-but-empty by an explicit earlier choice this change preserves rather than silently inverting into no-picker-no-error-nothing. The component's default is to render — hiding is an explicit opt-in that a caller may exercise only from a load that completed successfully, which is the inverse of its #288 sibling's default and deliberately so: the safe default reaches every caller including ones not yet migrated, and a follow-up moves the sibling to this polarity rather than this control to the unsafe one, with a site comment carrying the asymmetry until then. All three production callers are wired: the main agenda flow from its existing load flag, the season-manage panel gaining the loading flag it lacked, and the event detail page per its own lifecycle. STATED CHOICES: <GREEN agent fills>.
